A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, with readable and matchable text, equations, six tables, and ten figures. Neither includes an appendix; both end with references. Supplementary examples mentioned in both versions are not embedded in the supplied PDFs.

before.justification: v1 reports original model evaluations, feature and attention analyses, abstention experiments, and LLM-Pipeline results, including Table 2, Tables 5–6, and Figures 3–9. These are distinct from the externally reproduced results in Tables 3–4.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark evaluations, diagnostic analyses, and detector/pipeline experiments in Table 2, Tables 5–6, and Figures 3–9.

M1.justification: The Naive and Scenario variants, optional caption re-check, and LLM detection followed by VLLM response generation remain unchanged. Renaming the evaluator as a detector and explicitly describing rejection clarify the existing procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate VLSafe, FigStep, MM-SafetyBench, VLGuard, and MM-Vet, including the same benign-caption and safe-instruction scenarios. No dataset, task, or evaluated input scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is retained: Figure 9 still compares LLM-Pipeline with vanilla models, AdaShield-S, and PostHoc, while the other comparisons retain their methods and models. Figure 8 includes InternVL2 in both versions despite v1's inconsistent prose.

E3.justification: The caption re-check model is specified as QWen2-VL-14B in v1 Section 6.1 and QWen2-VL-7B in v2 Section 5.1. This revises a stated model configuration; the unchanged Table 6 values do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The feature and attention analyses, benign-input abstention tests, evaluator-agreement analysis, deliberate-abstention control, caption re-check comparison, and dataset-label case studies are retained. Reorganization introduces no additional ablation, robustness test, or case study.

E5.justification: Figure 7 retains the same Cohen's kappa analysis, and Figure 8 retains its error bars. No new run counts, seed information, uncertainty definitions, or significance-testing procedures are reported.

E6.justification: The MM-Vet finding of 100% abstention with slight accuracy loss is attributed to QWen2-VL in v1 Section 5.3 but corrected to Intern-VL2 in v2 Section 4.3, matching Figure 8 in both versions. All numerical table entries and plotted results are retained; no performance gain is newly demonstrated.

T1.justification: Equation (1), the safe/unsafe input-quadrant framework, and the three empirical remarks retain their substance. Neither version provides additional formal assumptions, theorems, proofs, or derivations.

C1.justification: The central safety-paradox, over-prudence, and evaluator-disagreement claims remain. v2's conclusion adds an explicit qualification that LLM-Pipeline is intended to illuminate the paradox, rather than establish a better jailbreak-defense baseline.

C2.justification: v2 explicitly interprets LLM-Pipeline's favorable results as illustrating benchmark saturation and uncertainty in defense evaluation, with minimal room for improving measured defense. Existing explanations of image-induced vulnerability, over-prudence, evaluator disagreement, and ambiguous safety labels remain.

D1.justification: v2 identifies Figure 4's attention source as LLaVA's [CLS] token and supplies a full example Scenario protection prompt. It also revises the stated captioner size from 14B to 7B. These are limited documentation additions and revisions.

R1.justification: Five works are newly cited, including JailbreakBench, InternVL, AutoJailbreak, a multimodal jailbreak survey, and an over-refusal study. The imgJP discussion and corresponding Niu et al. reference are removed. The broader literature taxonomy remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Related Work moves from Section 2 to Section 6, while the defense rationale is reorganized into separate over-prudence and evaluation-dilemma subsections. The abstract and introduction foreground explicit contributions, the method exposition is reorganized, and evaluator terminology becomes detector throughout. Together these substantially revise the narrative structure.

P2.justification: All six tables and ten figures remain. Displays are relocated and repacked, including arranging Tables 3–4 side by side; several captions are clarified, and Figure 2 replaces colored textual emphasis with underlining. The plots and table structures remain largely intact.

improvement.justification: v2 improves clarity and internal consistency through clearer organization, more precise detector terminology, additional technical detail, and correction of the MM-Vet model attribution to match Figure 8. These are limited reporting gains. The empirical evidence is retained, and the captioner-size revision remains unexplained as either a correction or a changed experiment.
